_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: FMEA-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

title.description: Title of the PFMEA; used as its display value in other collections

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prd_item.description

controlPlanName.description: Display value of controlPlanId, copied from u_mes_qlt_controlPlan.recordNo

originalDate.description: Original date (calendar date, stored as the start of that day in IST converted to UTC)

revisionDate.description: Revision date (calendar date, stored as the start of that day in IST converted to UTC)

approvedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user recorded for 'approved'

approvedBy.description: Display name of the user in approvedById, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

approvedAt.description: Date and time when the record was approved

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
